snippet.title: Chickenhare and the Treasure of Spiking-beard official trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into a legendary treasure hunt in a brand-new action-adventure game inspired by the beloved Chickenhare movie and graphic novel. A thrilling quest for all ages awaits when the game launches later this year on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5,  Xbox Series X/S and PC.

Learn more on : https://chickenhare.game/
Whishlist the game on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527820/Chickenhare_and_the_treasure_of_SpikingBeard/
